verdicts.why: The model identifies the same Samsung Eco Bubble 9kg washing machine shown in the photos.

A motorized height-adjustable desk is the same electric adjustable-height office desk.

The model correctly identifies the wall-mounted salon hair dryer and hair steamer set.
